item.title: Handing a 12M/week npm package to an AI for one week — the 5 guardrails worth keeping
item.description: An 11-year-old npm package (wait-on, ~12M weekly downloads) got its first week under a new maintainer run by coding agents: 27 PRs, 6 releases, plus a Rust dual-engine port that passed 496 tests. I ran the key numbers on my own machine — what's worth taking is 5 guardrails, not 'look what AI can do.'
